command: set -eu; echo HOST=$(hostname); echo USER=$(id -un); echo CPU=$(nproc); awk '/MemAvailable:/{print "MEM_AVAILABLE_KB="$2}' /proc/meminfo; echo LOAD=$(cut -d' ' -f1 /proc/loadavg); echo FRANK=$(command -v frank || true); echo VISIBLE=$(command -v frank-harness-sichtbar || true); for f in ~/.claude/star/stern.py ~/.claude/star/harness_aider.py ~/.claude/star/harness_audit.py; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then sha256sum "$f"; else echo MISSING:$f; fi; done; if [ -d ~/frankenstein-repo/.git ]; then echo REPO_HEAD=$(git -C ~/frankenstein-repo rev-parse HEAD); echo REPO_BRANCH=$(git -C ~/frankenstein-repo branch --show-current); echo REPO_DIRTY_BEGIN; git -C ~/frankenstein-repo status --porcelain; echo REPO_DIRTY_END; fi
